findings.message: This command string is run by a shell, and a value built into it is not a literal, so the shell parses that value as code: a `"`, `'` or space in it breaks the command, and a `$(...)` or backtick in it runs. Quoting it by hand is one escape away from the same bug. Pass the program and its arguments separately instead, `execFileSync('sqlite3', [databasePath, query])` (or `spawn` with an argument array and no `shell`), so no shell ever reads the value.
